description: This file declares the interface for the INativeJS component in WPEFramework, specifying methods for managing NativeJS applications such as initialization, creation, execution, and termination.

classes.name: INativeJS
classes.description: An interface for managing NativeJS applications within WPEFramework, allowing initialization, creation, running, and termination of applications.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the NativeJS plugin with a specified Wayland display.

methods.name: CreateApplication
methods.description: Creates a new NativeJS application with provided options and outputs its ID.

methods.name: RunApplication
methods.description: Runs an existing NativeJS application identified by its ID with a specified URL.

methods.name: RunJavaScript
methods.description: Executes JavaScript code within a NativeJS application identified by its ID.

methods.name: TerminateApplication
methods.description: Terminates a running NativeJS application by its ID.
